Pācittiya
Bud. Pāli. Part II in Suttavibhaṅga of Vinayapiṭaka. contains code of discipline an. expiation for monks.
See B. C. Law, His.. of Pāli Lit. p.. 46. 52-58.

Pt.. (1) with C. Samantapāsādikā of Buddhaghoṣa. Rangoon, 1902. See Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1906-28. 194. [Page006-b] (2) with Burmese interpretation by Jagarabhidhaja. Pt.. Rangoon, 1903-04. See Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1892-1906. 834. (3) Nālanda Dng. Pali. Ser. Patna, 1958.
--C. Aṭṭhakathā by Buddhaghoṣa. Colombo D. I. 1746.
